# EasyOpenHub

> Curated, local-first open-source Mac apps that replace paid subscriptions, each with a direct link to the developer's official .dmg (Apple Silicon / Intel / Universal), explained in plain English.

- [About & security](https://easyopenhub.com/en/about/)
- [Install guide](https://easyopenhub.com/en/guide/)
- [Alternatives to paid apps](https://easyopenhub.com/en/alternatives/)

## Mac apps
- [OpenReel Video](https://easyopenhub.com/en/openreel-video/): A CapCut-style video editor that keeps your footage on your own computer, with no watermark and no subscription. Replaces CapCut, Premiere Pro.
- [Kdenlive](https://easyopenhub.com/en/kdenlive/): A full multi-track video editor for Mac, Windows and Linux, with no watermark and no subscription. Replaces Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro.
- [Gifski](https://easyopenhub.com/en/gifski/): Turn any MP4 or screen recording into a sharp, small GIF on your Mac. Replaces GIF Brewery, Permute.
- [AppFlowy](https://easyopenhub.com/en/appflowy/): An open-source, private workspace alternative to Notion. Replaces Notion.
- [KeePassXC](https://easyopenhub.com/en/keepassxc/): Secure offline password manager stored entirely on your computer. Replaces 1Password, LastPass.
- [RustDesk](https://easyopenhub.com/en/rustdesk/): Access and control computers remotely without setup. Replaces TeamViewer, AnyDesk.
- [LocalSend](https://easyopenhub.com/en/localsend/): Share files and text securely across nearby devices without internet. Replaces AirDrop, Send Anywhere.
- [Audacity](https://easyopenhub.com/en/audacity/): Record and edit podcasts, voiceovers and music on your Mac without an Adobe subscription. Replaces Adobe Audition, Hindenburg.
- [Buzz](https://easyopenhub.com/en/buzz/): Transcribe audio and video to text on your own Mac, offline, with no per-minute fees. Replaces MacWhisper Pro, Otter.ai, Rev.
- [LibreOffice](https://easyopenhub.com/en/libreoffice/): A complete office suite (Word, Excel and PowerPoint equivalents) that opens Microsoft files, with no Microsoft 365 subscription. Replaces Microsoft 365, Excel, Microsoft Word.
- [Upscayl](https://easyopenhub.com/en/upscayl/): Enlarge and enhance low-resolution images using local AI. Replaces Topaz Gigapixel AI.
- [ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors](https://easyopenhub.com/en/onlyoffice/): An office suite that looks like Microsoft Office and keeps .docx, .xlsx and .pptx formatting, with no subscription. Replaces Microsoft 365, Excel, Microsoft Word.
- [GIMP](https://easyopenhub.com/en/gimp/): The best-known Photoshop alternative: layers, masks, retouching and RAW editing on your Mac, with no Adobe subscription. Replaces Adobe Photoshop.
- [Krita](https://easyopenhub.com/en/krita/): A professional painting app for digital art and comics on your Mac, with no subscription. Replaces Adobe Photoshop, Procreate, Clip Studio Paint.
- [Jan](https://easyopenhub.com/en/jan/): Run private AI models completely offline on your computer Replaces ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro.
- [Ollama](https://easyopenhub.com/en/ollama/): Run powerful AI models entirely on your own computer. Replaces ChatGPT Plus.
- [Kap](https://easyopenhub.com/en/kap/): Record your Mac screen easily from the menu bar. Replaces Screen Studio, CleanShot X, Loom.
- [Cap](https://easyopenhub.com/en/cap/): Record your screen and camera, polish it with zooms and backgrounds, and share a link: an open-source Loom alternative. Replaces Loom, Screen Studio.
- [OBS Studio](https://easyopenhub.com/en/obs-studio/): Free software for video recording and live streaming. Replaces Camtasia, ScreenFlow, Loom.
- [Shotcut](https://easyopenhub.com/en/shotcut/): A free, cross-platform desktop video editor for everyone. Replaces Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro.
- [IINA](https://easyopenhub.com/en/iina/): A modern media player designed specifically for macOS. Replaces Infuse, Elmedia Player.
- [Maccy](https://easyopenhub.com/en/maccy/): A lightweight clipboard history manager for your Mac. Replaces Paste, Pastebot.
- [Handy](https://easyopenhub.com/en/handy/): Free, offline speech-to-text dictation into any app Replaces Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, Dragon.
- [OpenWhispr](https://easyopenhub.com/en/openwhispr/): Voice-to-text dictation and meeting transcription for your desktop. Replaces Wispr Flow, Otter.ai.
- [FluidVoice](https://easyopenhub.com/en/fluidvoice/): Fast on-device voice dictation app for your Mac Replaces Superwhisper, Wispr Flow.
- [Inkscape](https://easyopenhub.com/en/inkscape/): A vector design app for logos, icons and print on your Mac: the classic Illustrator alternative, with no subscription. Replaces Adobe Illustrator.
- [darktable](https://easyopenhub.com/en/darktable/): A Lightroom-style RAW photo editor and library for your Mac, with no Adobe subscription. Replaces Adobe Lightroom, Capture One.
- [Joplin](https://easyopenhub.com/en/joplin/): Take notes and sync them securely across your devices. Replaces Evernote, Notion.
- [Zotero](https://easyopenhub.com/en/zotero/): Collect, organize, annotate, and cite your research sources. Replaces EndNote, Mendeley.
- [Flameshot](https://easyopenhub.com/en/flameshot/): Take screenshots and annotate them directly on your screen. Replaces CleanShot X, Snagit.
- [draw.io Desktop](https://easyopenhub.com/en/drawio-desktop/): Create diagrams and flowcharts completely offline on your computer. Replaces Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart.
- [Syncthing](https://easyopenhub.com/en/syncthing/): Continuous and secure file synchronization between your computers Replaces Dropbox, Google Drive.
- [Super Productivity](https://easyopenhub.com/en/super-productivity/): A private to-do list, time tracker, and daily planner. Replaces Todoist, Toggl Track, TickTick.
- [Meetily](https://easyopenhub.com/en/meetily/): Private, on-device AI meeting recorder and note-taker. Replaces Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai.
- [anarlog](https://easyopenhub.com/en/fastrepl-anarlog/): Privacy-focused AI meeting notepad that needs no call bots. Replaces Granola, Otter.ai.
- [Diffusion Bee](https://easyopenhub.com/en/diffusionbee-stable-diffusion-ui/): Run Stable Diffusion image generation locally on your Mac Replaces Midjourney.
- [Filee](https://easyopenhub.com/en/filee/): Drag and drop offline file converter supporting 270 formats. Replaces Permute, CloudConvert.
- [Voicebox](https://easyopenhub.com/en/voicebox/): Local AI voice studio to clone voices and dictate text Replaces ElevenLabs, Descript.
- [VoiceStudio](https://easyopenhub.com/en/voicestudio/): Local AI voice cloning, design, dubbing, and transcription. Replaces ElevenLabs.
- [Cherry Studio](https://easyopenhub.com/en/cherry-studio/): Desktop app to chat with multiple AI models and agents Replaces ChatGPT Plus, TypingMind.
- [NextChat](https://easyopenhub.com/en/nextchat/): Cross-platform AI chat app supporting multiple model providers Replaces ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro.
- [AnythingLLM](https://easyopenhub.com/en/anything-llm/): Chat with your private documents using local or cloud AI. Replaces ChatGPT Plus, NotebookLM.
- [Palmier Pro](https://easyopenhub.com/en/palmier-pro/): A macOS video editor built for AI and timeline generation. Replaces Final Cut Pro, Descript.
- [AutoClip](https://easyopenhub.com/en/autoclip/): Turn long videos into short clips with subtitles automatically Replaces Opus Clip.
- [Abogen](https://easyopenhub.com/en/abogen/): Turn eBooks, PDFs, and text into spoken audiobooks with subtitles Replaces Speechify, ElevenLabs.
- [ebook2audiobook](https://easyopenhub.com/en/ebook2audiobook/): Turn e-books into spoken audiobooks using local AI voices. Replaces Speechify, Audible.
- [Noi](https://easyopenhub.com/en/noi/): A focused desktop workspace for AI chats and browsing. Replaces ChatGPT Plus, Poe.
- [Khoj](https://easyopenhub.com/en/khoj/): Your personal AI second brain for search and chats. Replaces Notion AI, Mem.
- [ComfyUI](https://easyopenhub.com/en/comfyui/): Create AI images and videos with visual connected blocks. Replaces Midjourney, Adobe Firefly.
- [Generative AI for Krita](https://easyopenhub.com/en/krita-ai-diffusion/): Add local generative AI tools directly inside Krita Replaces Adobe Photoshop.
- [Stability Matrix](https://easyopenhub.com/en/stability-matrix/): One-click manager to install and run Stable Diffusion apps Replaces Midjourney.
- [SurfSense](https://easyopenhub.com/en/surfsense/): Air-gapped, open-source AI agent that analyzes and edits documents. Replaces NotebookLM.
- [Banana Slides](https://easyopenhub.com/en/banana-slides/): Turn ideas into presentation slides using generative AI models. Replaces Gamma.
- [PPT Master](https://easyopenhub.com/en/ppt-master/): AI turns documents or topics into natively editable PowerPoint presentations Replaces Gamma, Microsoft Copilot.
- [pyVideoTrans](https://easyopenhub.com/en/pyvideotrans/): Translate videos into other languages with AI dubbing and subtitles. Replaces HeyGen, Rask AI.
- [FunClip](https://easyopenhub.com/en/funclip/): Clip video clips simply by selecting transcribed speech text. Replaces Descript.
- [LobsterAI](https://easyopenhub.com/en/lobsterai/): Desktop AI agent that completes real office tasks and files Replaces Microsoft Copilot.
- [BrowserOS neo](https://easyopenhub.com/en/browseros/): A local secondary browser designed for your AI agents. Replaces Perplexity Comet.
- [BentoPDF](https://easyopenhub.com/en/bentopdf/): Process and edit PDF files entirely inside your browser. Replaces Adobe Acrobat, Smallpdf.
- [Excalidraw](https://easyopenhub.com/en/excalidraw/): Sketch hand-drawn diagrams on a collaborative whiteboard. Replaces Miro, Lucidchart.
- [uBlock Origin](https://easyopenhub.com/en/ublock-origin/): Block ads, trackers, and malicious sites in your browser. Replaces AdGuard, AdBlock Plus.
- [scrcpy](https://easyopenhub.com/en/scrcpy/): Display and control your Android phone from your computer. Replaces Vysor.
